# HireKrkeDekho

> HireKrkeDekho is an AI-powered engineering career advisory, technical benchmarking, and daily coding contest platform designed for software engineers, developers, and tech professionals in India.

## Key Links
- [Home & Platform Overview](https://hirekrkedekho.in/): Next-generation AI career roadmap engine and daily technical benchmarking contest.
- [AI Career Advisor](https://hirekrkedekho.in/consultation): Interactive 1-on-1 career consultation tailored to tech stacks, salary bands (LPA), and Indian tech hubs.
- [Daily Tech Contest](https://hirekrkedekho.in/#ai_race): 15 rapid-fire technical challenges with 15-second countdowns and live leaderboards.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hirekrkedekho.in/privacy-policy): Platform data security and candidate privacy commitments.

## City & Role Calibration Hubs (/jobs)
- [Python Backend Developer in Bangalore](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/python-backend-developer-bangalore): Verified roles (₹8–16 LPA), required skills, and interview milestones.
- [FastAPI Developer in Pune](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/fastapi-developer-pune): Openings (₹7–14 LPA) and async backend preparation.
- [Junior ML Engineer in Hyderabad](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/junior-ml-engineer-hyderabad): Machine learning roles (₹10–18 LPA) across Hyderabad tech companies.
- [Data Analyst in Gurgaon](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/data-analyst-gurgaon): Analytics roles (₹6–12 LPA) requiring SQL, Python, and PowerBI.
- [Full Stack React & Node in Bangalore](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/fullstack-react-node-bangalore): MERN stack developer positions (₹9–20 LPA).
- [DevOps & AWS Cloud Engineer in Mumbai](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/devops-aws-engineer-mumbai): Cloud infrastructure openings (₹8–17 LPA).
- [Remote Software Engineer in India](https://hirekrkedekho.in/jobs/remote-software-engineer-india): Pan-India high-paying remote roles (₹10–25 LPA).

## 3-Week Technical Roadmaps (/roadmap)
- [Python & FastAPI Backend Roadmap](https://hirekrkedekho.in/roadmap/backend-python-fastapi): 3-week async backend interview guide.
- [Machine Learning Engineer Roadmap](https://hirekrkedekho.in/roadmap/machine-learning-engineer-india): 3-week math, PyTorch, and deployment roadmap.
- [Data Analyst Preparation Roadmap](https://hirekrkedekho.in/roadmap/data-analyst-sql-python): 3-week SQL, EDA, and business metrics roadmap.
- [Modern Frontend React 19 Roadmap](https://hirekrkedekho.in/roadmap/frontend-react-nextjs): 3-week React, Next.js, and machine coding guide.
- [System Design Roadmap](https://hirekrkedekho.in/roadmap/system-design-fresher-to-mid): 3-week HLD, LLD, and scalable systems roadmap.

## Core Capabilities
- **Tri-Factor Matching Engine**: Calibrates career recommendations across Degree, Years of Experience, and Core Technical Stack.
- **AI Career Advisor**: Conversational advisor providing structured role analysis, salary bands (LPA), and tailored 3-week preparation guides for Indian tech hubs.
- **Daily AI Race**: Daily 15-question rapid-fire technical benchmarking contest testing algorithms, data structures, and system design with server-timed anti-cheat and live leaderboards.
